exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners examination
exams.notes: Also requires an examination of applicable Missouri statutes and regulations promulgated or approved by the board.
exams.quote: The examination shall and will consist of the examination offered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners, as well as an examination of applicable Missouri statutes and regulations which shall be promulgated or approved by the board.

interval_years.quote: Each person applying for biennial license renewal shall complete the form and return it to the board on or before the renewal date for the licensing period for which the person desires to be registered.

required.quote: Each applicant shall give with the application for biennial license renewal satisfactory evidence of completion of twenty-four hours of postgraduate study for each renewal period since the last issuance or renewal of the license.

hours_per_period.quote: satisfactory evidence of completion of twenty-four hours of postgraduate study for each renewal period

period_years.quote: twenty-four hours of postgraduate study for each renewal period since the last issuance or renewal of the license

available.quote: the board shall, under regulations established by the board, admit without examination legally qualified practitioners of podiatric medicine who hold licenses to practice podiatric medicine in any foreign country with equal educational requirements to the state of Missouri upon the applicant paying a fee equivalent to the license and examination fees required above.

requirements.value: Admission without examination for legally qualified practitioners from foreign countries with equal educational requirements, upon payment of equivalent license and examination fees.

national_certification.quote: the doctor of podiatric medicine licensed pursuant to this chapter shall either be board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or shall complete a twenty-four-month postgraduate clinical residency in podiatric surgery

national_association.quote: The postgraduate study required shall be that presented by a college of podiatric medicine accredited by the American Podiatric Medical Association or a course of study approved by the board.

title_protection.quote: any person not being lawfully authorized to practice podiatric medicine in this state and licensed as aforesaid, who shall advertise as a podiatrist, in any form, or hold himself out to the public as a podiatrist or who shall practice as a podiatrist shall be guilty of a class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substances or alcohol to an extent that impairs ability to perform professional duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final conviction or guilty plea for a crime reasonably related to the profession, involving fraud, dishonesty, violence, or moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution under the laws of any state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation, or bribery in securing a certificate, permit, or license, or to obtain permission to take an examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any certificate of registration or authority, permit or license issued pursuant to this chapter or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition, or other compensation by fraud, deception, or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency, misconduct, repeated negligence, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonesty in professional performance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency, misconduct, repeated negligence, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of, or assisting others to violate, any provision of this chapter or lawful rules adopted pursuant thereto.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of this chapter, or of any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating a licensed person or allowing another to use one's certificate, license, permit, or diploma.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license or allowing any person to use his or her certificate of registration or authority, permit, license or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action against the holder by another state, territory, federal agency, or country on grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in Missouri.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against the holder of a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by this chapter granted by another state, territory, federal agency or country upon grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of insanity or incompetence by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling any unlicensed person to practice or offer to practice a regulated profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter who is not registered and currently eligible to practice pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of a certificate, permit, or license based upon a material mistake of fact.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to display a valid certificate or license as required by this chapter or rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to display a valid certificate or license if so required by this chapter or any rule promulgated hereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any professional trust or confidence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any professional trust or confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any advertisement or solicitation that is false, misleading, or deceptive to the general public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any advertisement or solicitation which is false, misleading or deceptive to the general public or persons to whom the advertisement or solicitation is primarily directed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, any other state, or the federal government.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, any other state or the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious, or communicable diseases or their spread.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious or communicable diseases or the spread thereof.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, with the exception of administration of general anesthetics, or amputation of the foot and with the further exception that the definitions shall not apply to bone surgery on children under the age of one year
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, with the exception of administration of general anesthetics, or amputation of the foot and with the further exception that the definitions shall not apply to bone surgery on children under the age of one year

methods_authorized.quote: treat in any manner the human foot by medical, mechanical, or surgical methods

drug_authority.value: Use of drugs and medicines in the treatment of ailments of the human foot is authorized, but shall not include the treatment of any systemic diseases.
drug_authority.quote: The use of such drugs and medicines in the treatment of ailments of the human foot shall not include the treatment of any systemic diseases.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the term "human foot" includes the ankle and the tendons which insert into the foot as well as the foot.

amputation_authorized.quote: with the exception of administration of general anesthetics, or amputation of the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: with the exception of administration of general anesthetics

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: For surgery of the ankle only, the doctor of podiatric medicine licensed pursuant to this chapter shall either be board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or shall complete a twenty-four-month postgraduate clinical residency in podiatric surgery

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: shall either be board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or shall complete a twenty-four-month postgraduate clinical residency in podiatric surgery

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Surgical treatment of the ankle by a doctor of podiatric medicine shall be performed only in a licensed acute care hospital or a licensed ambulatory surgical clinic.

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: The use of such drugs and medicines in the treatment of ailments of the human foot shall not include the treatment of any systemic diseases.

board_certification_body.quote: board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: This chapter shall further not apply to manufacturers of and dealers in shoes or corrective appliances for deformed feet; provided, however, that such manufacturers and dealers shall not be entitled to practice podiatric medicine, as in this chapter defined, unless duly licensed so to do as herein provided.
